This plot is my cassava and sweet potato land, intercropped like my father taught me. Here in Mwanza the rains come once and the soil is sandy, so I rely on the rains and my hoe — fertilizer is expensive and for cassava it is not worth the shillings. I will use the cuttings I saved from last season, and my wife and I will do most of the work, but I will hire a few people for clearing and the first weeding.
